scope: Sector update description only; no farming or course instruction
sourceEnglish: Sector maps show clearer wind and rain symbols, with slope and contours kept visible.

translations.zu: Amamephu eSector abonisa izimpawu zomoya nezemvula ezicace kakhudlwana, kanti umthambeka nemigqa yokuphakama kuhlala kubonakala.
translations.st: Limmapa tsa Sector di bontsha matshwao a hlakileng ho feta a moya le pula, ha moepa le mela ya bophahamo di ntse di bonahala.
translations.ts: Mimepe ya Sector yi komba mimfungho ya moya ni mpfula leyi nga erivaleni swinene, naswona ku voyama ni milayeni yo tlakuka swi tshamaka swi vonaka.
translations.ve: Mimepe ya Sector i sumbedza zwiga zwa muya na mvula zwi re khagala nga u engedza, ngeno mutevhe na mitalo ya vhulapfu zwi tshi dzula zwi tshi vhonala.
